_what: The optional MuJoCo player for Nong sequences (tools/nong_sim, user 2026-10-27: see the dance in a 3D physics world, any number of robots). Nothing in the hub or Studio needs it. rig: a rig file Studio saved (or a settings backup) to move like THIS robot; null = the shipped rig_default.json. safeDps: the board's safety cap on peak joint speed; null = the firmware default. physics: timestep s, density of the printed parts kg/m3 (no weighed parts yet, so arm sag is an estimate), jointDamping N.m.s/rad, armature kg.m2 (the servo's own gearbox inertia). servo: how a hobby servo follows the board's 50 Hz targets - it turns no faster than the rig's servoMaxDps, lags by lagMs (first order, a guess until measured on the bench), and gives its full stall torque (tools/make_urdf.py EFFORT_NM, times the joint's gear) once it is fullTorqueDeg away from its target; kvPerKp = damping per stiffness, s; shrugSlideKp = N/m holding each shoulder on its measured 4-bar height (a measured shrugCurve only). robots: how many robots stand in the world, spacingMm apart; vary.lagMs = each robot gets its own lag spread across this range so one run shows how much the servo's real lag would matter. report: nearMm = how close counts as a near miss; null = Studio's own safety gap (collisions.js CLEAR + rig extraClearanceMm). view: speed 1 = real time; loop = start again at the end.
